column4: The example JWT_SECRET passes the startup check
a missing secret is swallowed in verifySessionToken's catch, so it shows up as a login loop
There is no rate limiting on login or register
login skips bcrypt when the email is unknown, so response timing reveals whether an account exists; register returns 409
register does check-then-create; concurrent signups hit a unique-constraint error, unhandled, 500

Idea lifecycle rules are not enforced: PATCH accepts status on its own; DONE with no outcome; ACTIVE with hindsight attached; calibration filters on hindsightTotal; CHECK constraints do not cover all-or-nothing
The Edit button stays available after an outcome is recorded. Prediction scores can be rewritten after the fact, which defeats the point of the tool
Sessions can't be revoked; no password change or reset
There is no production database path: only prisma migrate dev, no migrate deploy, no Dockerfile or deploy doc
docker-compose.yml publishes Postgres with the password idealog on all interfaces
Network failures leave the UI stuck; no fetch has a try/catch; delete, share and logout ignore failures silently
Validation errors are shown raw, and only the first issue
No error handling on the server: no error.tsx, no not-found page, no try/catch around Prisma calls
no logging or health endpoint
No security headers: next.config.ts is empty
Route handlers rely on SameSite=Lax alone and never check Origin or Content-Type
Passwords are silently truncated at 72 bytes (confirmed)
/s/[token] has no noindex, and links can never expire
/s/[token] has no Referrer-Policy
The share page queries the database twice, once in generateMetadata and once in the page
/api/share/[token] is unused by the UI yet duplicates the serialization and adds a public endpoint
Two likely hydration mismatches: toLocaleDateString in idea-detail; share-control renders a different URL on the server
Nothing is paginated: GET /api/ideas and /ideas load every idea with full text, then re-sort in JavaScript
An invalid ?status= is silently ignored and returns everything
No tests and no CI
tsc --noEmit on its own fails with Cannot find name 'LayoutProps'; CI needs a typegen step first
pnpm audit reports one high finding, deepmerge-ts under prisma > @prisma/config; move prisma to devDependencies
Product gaps: no password reset, email verification or account deletion; the last one matters for privacy obligations
The untracked .claude/settings.json allows npx, node and pnpm install and mentions tools this repo doesn't use
The documented default JWT_SECRET is a public secret that passes validation
a missing secret throws inside proxy.ts on every /ideas request, so users get a 500
There is no brute-force or abuse protection on auth; bcryptjs cost 12 took about 400 ms of CPU per hash here
Existing accounts can be detected: distinct 409 on register; login returns early with no bcrypt work
Passwords longer than 72 bytes are silently truncated (confirmed)
There is no production migration path: only prisma migrate dev; no migrate deploy, Dockerfile or CI; README deploy story is pnpm dev
Sessions can't be revoked: logout only clears the cookie; JWT valid 30 days; no server-side session or version check
no password reset, email verification, password change or account deletion; deletion and export matter if you hold real users' data
Zero tests and no CI. Highest-value tests: ownership checks on every [id] route, share-token revoke and rotate, and score validation
Prediction scores can be edited after the outcome is recorded; PATCH accepts the four scores at any time and keeps no history; undermines the point of the app
PATCH accepts inconsistent states: DONE/ABANDONED with no outcome; back to ACTIVE with hindsight remaining; calibration keys off hindsightTotal
Ownership checks are separate from the writes: findFirst({id,userId}) then update/delete({where:{id}}); concurrent delete gives unhandled P2025 500
Registration has a race: findUnique then create; P2002 unhandled 500
No route wraps Prisma calls in try/catch, so any DB error is an opaque 500 with no logging
There are no security headers: no CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy or poweredByHeader: false
The share page has no robots: noindex, and its token sits in the URL; an unlisted link posted publicly can be indexed
Client error handling is thin: every fetch lacks try/catch; delete and share-control actions fail silently; clipboard rejections unhandled
Sharing exposes more than the UI says: /s/[token] and /api/share/[token] include the outcome text and hindsight scores; the UI says only anyone with the link can view this idea
every page renders SiteHeader, which reads the session and queries the DB, so every route is dynamic; public pages get a DB query per view and can't be cached
No pagination: /ideas and GET /api/ideas load all of a user's ideas including 5,000-character fields and sort in memory
Possible hydration mismatch: share-control.tsx branches on typeof window
docker-compose.yml: Postgres published on all interfaces with idealog/idealog credentials
pnpm audit: one high advisory, deepmerge-ts <8.0.0, reached only through the Prisma CLI; low risk
Idea_userId_idx is redundant with Idea_userId_status_idx
jwtVerify should pass { algorithms: ['HS256'] } explicitly
The secure cookie flag depends on NODE_ENV, so a plain-HTTP production deploy fails silently at login
The proxy builds its redirect from req.url, which can be the wrong host behind some reverse proxies
The README has a typo, unshareable/unguessable
tsc --noEmit alone fails on LayoutProps because that type is generated by next build or next typegen
.claude/settings.json (untracked) allows unprompted npx, node, pnpm install and pnpm exec; references tools that don't exist here
tsc --noEmit fails on a fresh checkout (LayoutProps not found) until next build or next typegen has run
pnpm audit reports one high finding: deepmerge-ts via the Prisma CLI, dev-time only
The placeholder JWT_SECRET passes validation; getSecretKey only rejects secrets under 16 characters; the check runs on the first request, not at boot
No brute-force protection on the auth endpoints; every attempt costs a bcrypt hash at cost 12, a cheap CPU-exhaustion vector
Login skips the hash when the email doesn't exist so timing reveals registered emails; register returns a distinct 409
Registration race returns a 500: findUnique then create; P2002 unhandled
none of the routes have a try/catch, so other DB errors surface as raw 500s too
The edit endpoint can break the calibration data: set status DONE/ABANDONED with no outcome, or back to ACTIVE while outcome and hindsight stay
rewrite the prediction scores after hindsight is recorded, which defeats the were-my-predictions-right purpose; Edit stays available after an outcome is recorded
send {} to PATCH /api/ideas/[id] and succeed, doing nothing
Sessions can't be revoked: JWT valid 30 days, logout only clears the browser cookie
no password reset, password change or account deletion
bcrypt silently truncates at 72 bytes (confirmed) while the schema accepts up to 200
No production deploy path: only prisma migrate dev; production needs migrate deploy; no Dockerfile
There is no Dockerfile, CI, health endpoint or tests
docker-compose.yml publishes Postgres on 5432 with idealog/idealog credentials
next.config.ts sets no security headers: CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy
/s/[token] has no robots: noindex
/s/[token] has no Referrer-Policy: no-referrer; the token is in the URL so it can leak to any site the viewer navigates to
The public endpoints aren't rate limited
/api/share/[token] duplicates the page's data logic, and no component I read calls it
CSRF: protection relies on SameSite=lax alone; no Origin check; routes parse JSON without checking Content-Type
Unbounded reads: GET /api/ideas and /ideas load every idea with full descriptions and sort in JS
Silent failures in the client: fetch isn't wrapped in try/catch in the forms; delete and share failures ignored; clipboard unguarded
Raw Zod messages reach users
No error pages: no error.tsx or custom not-found.tsx
Invalid ?status= is ignored: silently returns all ideas instead of a 400
README typo: unshareable/unguessable link
The score CHECK constraints exist only in raw SQL, not in schema.prisma; say so in the README
.claude/settings.json is untracked and allowlists tools this repo doesn't use
